payload.subject: DRY Self-Review Report Format for Expedition Changes
payload.name: DRY Self-Review Report Format for Expedition Changes
payload.goal: Codify the DRY self-review report format and checklist used during Single-Source Branch Naming (expedition 190a72e71fbe3c14) so every expedition verifies its own changes for DRY compliance before PR: (1) enumerate every file changed by the expedition, (2) audit each change for duplication/dead code/redundant helpers, (3) confirm all call sites funnel through a single source of truth, (4) verify removal of parallel implementations, (5) run tsc + affected tests, (6) produce the per-file DRY report table as evidence. Evidence-gathering / process expedition — output is a documented review format, not new framework features.
